text:
jordan: Quick sync — NimbusPay escalation. Customer seeing p99 tail ~3x SLA. CS flagged, need cross-team commitments for hotfix + routing fallback + timeline. @sam @lee @priya

sam: I'm on infra oncall this week. I can take routing fallback + canary. ETA ~45m to prepare config and tests.

priya: I can own the hotfix PR. Found a flaky KV cache eviction pattern causing stalls under high prefix reuse. Branch: fix/nimbus-kv-evict. Needs review + CI.

lee: If it's KV eviction, runtime patch + kernel tweak from eng-ml required. Looping @sanjay. Also recommend scaling pool3 temporarily while we validate.

maria: CS note — NimbusPay legal wants an exact ETA and a short workaround copy for customers. Can we confirm 1h or 3h?

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 (NIMBUSPAY-EMERG). PagerDuty notified.

sam: Scaling pool3 now (adding 2 nodes), should finish in ~12m. Kicking off smoke tests after scale. Running: /runbook scale-gpu pool3

priya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842 — tests failing on macOS runner (unrelated). @sam can you review? If you're busy, @lee feel free to merge with rollback plan.

sam: Will review in ~20m. If CI green, can merge and push canary. Recommend canary to 5% traffic, monitor p99.

lee: Agree. Routing fallback config I'll apply post-canary if we see no regressions. Snippet:
```
routes:
  - match: nimbuspay-prod
    fallback: model-variant-small
    weight: 5%
```

priya: Note: hotfix touches kernel call ordering — plan B is to revert routing to stable model-variant-small. Need eng-ml sign-off before kernel tweak ships.

sanjay: sanjay: saw this thread — will prioritize kernel review. If we can't land within 2h, approve rollback to model-variant-small. I pinged the model-team for extra eyes.

maria: CS copy draft: "We are temporarily routing a small percentage of requests to a lower-latency model variant while engineers deploy a fix. Expected customer impact: slight increase in latency for a subset of requests; no data loss." Is that safe to send in 30m?

sam: Confirmed: model-variant-small adds ~+25% latency in our perf tests, within customer tolerance. I'll attach perf numbers to the status note.

jordan: Action items recap — Priya: hotfix PR owner; Sam: canary + scale; Lee: routing + rollback; Sanjay: kernel review; Maria: customer comms. Checkpoints: 12m (scale done), 45m (canary), 2h (fix vs rollback decision). I'll update INC ticket with these milestones.

priya: I'll add a small stress test to PR to validate kv stability:
```
python tests/kv_stress.py --runs 100 --seq 1024
```

ops-bot: INC-2026-042 updated: owners assigned. Links: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-042

jordan: :thumbsup: thanks all. Ping here immediately if anything slips past the 2h window or perf looks worse than expected.
